theorems.name: Submission.tdo_graph_plane_dist
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (A v)))) = n ∧ (∀ x : Amb n ℓ, infDist x (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (A v))) : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ infDist x (rotatedPlane q : Set (Amb n ℓ)) + hsNorm A * ‖x‖) ∧ (∀ (x' : Rn n) (y c : Rn ℓ), infDist (q (graphPoint x' y) - q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (A v))) : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ ‖y - (c + A x')‖) ∧ (∀ (x' : Rn n) (y c : Rn ℓ), ‖x'‖ ≤ ‖q (graphPoint x' y) - q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)‖) ∧ ∀ c : Rn ℓ, ‖q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)‖ = ‖c‖
